case.summary: This case was triggered by a real-time model risk score of 0.90 on transaction 3503878, an online purchase of $99.92 on card C07987-K2. Investigation revealed that the transaction was conducted using a new device profile, 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720', which has never been seen on this account. A connected-components scan linked this device profile to four other cardholders (cards C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, and C11309-K1) who experienced similar transactions between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-04. Based on the shared device profile and historical fraud patterns, the transaction is confirmed as card-not-present fraud. We have blocked the card, initiated a case, placed connected cards under monitoring, and filed a report.

sar.narrative: On 2016-12-01 at 17:28:53, an unauthorized online transaction of $99.92 (ID 3503878) was attempted on card C07987-K2, held by customer C07987. The transaction originated from a device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' which was marked as new and had no prior association with this cardholder. Network analysis revealed that this exact device profile was shared across five different cardholders, including C07987, between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-04, totaling five transactions and $500.00 in exposure. The other connected cards involved in this activity are C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, and C11309-K1. This coordinated pattern of a single device profile accessing multiple unrelated accounts within a short timeframe is highly indicative of card-not-present fraud. Similar historical cases, such as CC-2878 and CC-3438, confirm this behavioral fingerprint as fraudulent. Consequently, the bank has blocked card C07987-K2, placed the connected cards under monitoring, and is filing this report to document the suspicious activity.

stop_reason: Action is taken in accordance with Policy Section 6, specifically R2, which mandates blocking the card and filing a report when unauthorized activity connects to a shared device profile.
